mapper.insert: INSERT INTO attachment_blobs(sha256,size_bytes,media_kind,media_type,created_at) VALUES(#{sha256},#{sizeBytes},#{mediaKind},#{mediaType},#{createdAt}) ON CONFLICT(sha256) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT a.attachment_id,a.workspace_id,a.blob_sha256,a.content_sha256,a.display_name,a.size_bytes, a.media_kind,a.media_type,a.status,a.created_at,a.expires_at,ta.turn_id AS bound_turn_id FROM attachments a LEFT JOIN turn_attachments ta ON ta.attachment_id=a.attachment_id WHERE a.attachment_id=#{attachmentId}

SELECT a.attachment_id,a.workspace_id,a.blob_sha256,a.content_sha256,a.display_name,a.size_bytes, a.media_kind,a.media_type,a.status,a.created_at,a.expires_at,ta.turn_id AS bound_turn_id FROM attachments a JOIN turn_attachments ta ON ta.attachment_id=a.attachment_id JOIN turns t ON t.turn_id=ta.turn_id WHERE a.attachment_id=#{attachmentId} AND t.thread_id=#{threadId} AND a.status='BOUND'
mapper.update: UPDATE attachments SET status='DISCARDED',discarded_at=#{discardedAt},blob_sha256=NULL WHERE attachment_id=#{attachmentId} AND status='DRAFT'
UPDATE attachments SET status='EXPIRED',expired_at=#{expiredAt},blob_sha256=NULL WHERE status='DRAFT' AND expires_at<=#{expiredAt}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM attachment_blobs WHERE sha256=#{sha256} AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM attachments a WHERE a.blob_sha256=#{sha256} AND a.status IN ('DRAFT','BOUND'))
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO thread_title_generations(generation_id,thread_id,turn_id,provider_id,model_id,config_generation,claimed_at) VALUES(#{generationId},#{threadId},#{turnId},#{providerId},#{modelId},#{configGeneration},#{claimedAt}) ON CONFLICT(thread_id) DO NOTHING
